value.rationale: A natural complete orbit-type classification for all connected graphs reduces a dynamical problem to rainbow colourings of components after independent vertex deletion. It gives a sharp obstruction at maximum degree two and explicit biclique counts, not merely a rephrased special-family enumeration.
